description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) is out for the next two months with a hamstring injury he suffered in training camp.
items.impact: It's a tough blow to the Saints, who were hopeful to have their full complement of weapons to start the year. The timeline puts Tyson returning near the middle of October, and expect a ramp-up period for him once he returns. For those who haven't drafted yet, expect his ADP to fall dramatically as he will be unusable foe the first several weeks of the season, if not longer.
items.title: Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) out for two months with hamstring injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Rams expect Myles Garrett to be back at practice next week.
items.impact: Garrett remains sidelined for now with a knee injury. He still has a few weeks ahead of the season opener.
items.title: Myles Garrett (knee) expected back at practice next week

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jackson Powers-Johnson exited Monday's practice early with an apparent injury.
items.impact: Powers-Johnson was able to walk off the field with trainers. There should be an update on his status by Tuesday.
items.title: Jackson Powers-Johnson leaves practice early Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Rams head coach Sean McVay said Puka Nacua is still dealing with soreness in his groin.
items.impact: Nacua suffered the injury during practice last week. He was hopeful to return to practice this week, but that appears to be up in the air. He was not at practice on Monday.
items.title: Puka Nacua still dealing with soreness in groin

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jaguars head coach Liam Coen said he is "trending toward" playing the starters in Friday's preseason game against the Panthers.
items.impact: The Jaguars starters did not see the field in last week's preseason opener. If they do play, it'll likely be in limited fashion.
items.title: Trevor Lawrence: Jaguars starters 'trending' towards playing Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Giants head coach John Harbaugh said he doesn't think Malik Nabers is "at full-speed yet" after returning to team drills.
items.impact: It is still a step in the right direction for Nabers as he continues to work his way back from a torn ACL last season. He continues to trend in the right direction to being ready to go for Week 1.
items.title: Malik Nabers (knee) not yet at full speed in team drills

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The 49ers released RB Khalil Herbert.
items.impact: Herbert will figure to seek another opportunity to compete for a depth role during training camp.
items.title: Khalil Herbert released by 49ers

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: Luke Wattenberg made his return to practice on Monday in limited fashion.
items.impact: Wattenberg did not practice last week, but he was able to participate in individual drills in side field work on Monday. He is likely not back to full strength yet, but he is a crucial piece of the Denver offensive line heading into the season.
items.title: Luke Wattenberg returns to practice Monday

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: Marvin Mims Jr. returned to practice in a limited fashion on Monday.
items.impact: Mims Jr. participated in stretching and drills before working off to the side at Monday's practice after missing all of last week. The wideout will likely slowly build back to full strength, but should be good to go for Week 1, barring any setbacks.
items.title: Marvin Mims Jr. returns to limited practice Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Buccaneers coach Todd Bowles did not have any clarity on the return of WR Emeka Egbuka.
items.impact: "Not sure at this time," Bowles said when asked if Egbuka's injury could impact his Week 1 status. He'll need to continue to be monitored over the next couple of weeks.
items.title: Emeka Egbuka: No update on return per HC Todd Bowles

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: Jaylen Waddle returned to practice on Monday after dealing with a leg muscle strain.
items.impact: Waddle missed practice all of last week, but has now returned to action at the start of this week. The wideout should still be monitored throughout the week to see if an injury pops back up.
items.title: Jaylen Waddle (leg) returns to practice Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bears are expected to sign veteran DL Marcus Davenport.
items.impact: Davenport appeared in eight games with the Lions last season. He'll add depth on the defensive line for Chicago.
items.title: Marcus Davenport expected to sign with Bears

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Falcons signed WR Beaux Collins.
items.impact: Collins was waived with an injury settlement last week by the Giants. He will add depth in the wide receiver room for the Falcons.
items.title: Beaux Collins signs with Falcons

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Drew Stevens has earned the starting kicking job for the Commanders.
items.impact: Washington released Jake Moody on Monday. Stevens signed with the Commanders as an undrafted free agent out of Iowa this year.
items.title: Drew Stevens earns kicking job for Commanders

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Commanders are releasing kicker Jake Moody.
items.impact: Moody went 19-of-23 on field goals last season, including 10-for-11 in Washington. He'll figure to seek another opportunity.
items.title: Jake Moody released by Commanders

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Browns coach Todd Monken said the team is hopeful Carson Schwesinger will return to practice next week.
items.impact: Monken said the team is being "overly cautious" with Schwesinger. He hasn't practiced since July 31.
items.title: Carson Schwesinger hopeful to return to practice next week

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Titans rookie RB Nicholas Singleton was not seen practicing on Monday.
items.impact: Singleton also missed practice on Saturday. The rookie is competing for an immediate depth role in the Titans backfield. He saw eight carries in the preseason opener.
items.title: Nicholas Singleton not seen practicing Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Tony Pollard did not practice on Monday.
items.impact: Pollard previously also missed practice on Saturday. He saw four carries for 22 yards and a touchdown in the team's preseason opener.
items.title: Tony Pollard (foot) not seen practicing Monday

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: Makai Lemon will once again miss practice on Monday with a hamstring injury.
items.impact: Lemon has been out for nearly two weeks as he continues to deal with a hamstring injury. This is becoming a legitimate concern for the rookie, as Week 1 is now less than one month away and he will likely need a ramp-up period once he is deemed fully healthy.
items.title: Makai Lemon (hamstring) remains sidelined for Monday's practice

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: DeVonta Smith returned to practice on Monday as he continues to deal with a hamstring injury.
items.impact: This is an encouraging sign for Smith, who has missed the last two weeks of camp with a hamstring injury. While he will likely return in a limited capacity early this week, he should be monitored to see how his hamstring responds to being back at practice.
items.title: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) returns to practice Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Dolphins activated WR Chris Bell from the non-football injury list.
items.impact: Bell has been recovering from a torn ACL he suffered last season at Louisville. He'll slowly be eased back into training camp with Miami.
items.title: Chris Bell (knee) activated from NFI list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Commanders signed RB Craig Reynolds.
items.impact: Reynolds will add depth for Washington with Jeremy McNichols (quad) expected to miss the next few weeks.
items.title: Craig Reynolds signs with Commanders

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Vikings officially placed LB Jamal Adams on season-ending injured reserve.
items.impact: Adams suffered a season-ending injury in the Vikings preseason opener.
items.title: Jamal Adams (knee) placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Giants signed QB Jake Haener.
items.impact: Haener worked out for the Giants in July. He should see some action in the preseason.
items.title: Jake Haener signs with Giants

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Free agent RB Najee Harris is visiting the Giants on Monday.
items.impact: Harris is working his way back from a torn Achilles suffered last season. He would add depth in the backfield for the Giants.
items.title: Najee Harris visits Giants Monday

title: Fantasy Player News
